title: 32nd Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/32/1/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: a no-confidence motion against Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation Mohamed Ameen, submitted under the Constitution and the Majlis Standing Orders (the article numbers are dropped in the text layer).
Judiciary Committee report on the bill on preventing gang crimes and other dangerous crimes.

Judiciary Committee report on its re-review of the Attorney General's Office Bill, after the Majlis sent the bill back to the committee for further completion (report number garbled in the text layer).
Decentralisation Committee report on the bill to amend the Decentralisation Act (law number dropped in the text layer; this is Law No. 7/2010).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting tabled a no-confidence motion against the transport minister and took committee reports on the gang-crime prevention bill, the Attorney General's Office Bill and a Decentralisation Act amendment.
